true_answer: In other words, { ..., − 2 , − 1 , 0 , 1 , 2 ,... } . 4. Here we want all numbers x such that x and − x are natural numbers. There is only one: 0. So we have the set { 0 } . There is also a subtle variation on set builder notation. While the condition is generally given after the “such that”, sometimes it is hidden in the first part. Here is an example.
